visualCharacteristics.description: White band with horizontal carousel of product cards (optional ISOCLEAN Certified badge, product image, product name link, text link + outlined button, 3 bullet benefits) with prev/next arrows and dots. Option grid: 4-column wrapping listing of white tiles (1px #dbdbdb border, 6px radius), blue title link, bold Benefits label, bullets, Learn More text link + filled navy pill, with a See all (N) toggle when more than 4 tiles.

contentPattern.description: One row per product card. Cell 1: optional badge image followed by the product image. Cell 2: title (heading or bold) linked to the product page, a text link, a button link (last link renders as outlined button), and a bullet list of benefits. Optional (any mode): a short link-free paragraph immediately before the bullet list (e.g. "Benefits") is styled as the list label. Use Cards-Products (grid) for product listing grids.
contentPattern.structure: N rows (6 on source) x 2 cells: image cell + text cell

options.label: Grid
options.description: Wrapping product listing grid (1/2/4 columns at <768/768-991/>=992px) instead of the carousel; no arrows or dots. With more than 4 cards, the first 4 show and a "See all (N) >" button reveals the rest. Actions sit at the tile bottom and the last link renders as a filled navy pill. A link-free paragraph directly before the bullet list (e.g. "Benefits") renders as the list label.

suitableFor: product cards with image, title, links and benefit bullets
product listing grids grouped by category (option grid)
